iPhone
iPhone net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
Mac
Mac net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of laptops and desktops.
iPad
iPad net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad, partially 
offset by lower net sales of iPad Pro.
Wearables, Home and Accessories
Wearables, Home and Accessories net sales decreased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to lower net sales of 
Accessories and Wearables.
Services
Services net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store 
and cloud services.
